Quantiles of a Distribution Function

Source: R/BMisc.R
quantile.BMisc_dist.Rd

Quantiles of a distribution function created by make_dist (and so by weighted_ecdf and combine_ecdfs), computed by inverting it directly: for a step function, the smallest support point \(y\) with \(F(y) \ge p\) (the generalized inverse, type = 1 in quantile); for method = "linear", the inverse of the piecewise-linear \(F\).

Sample-quantile types other than 1 interpolate between order statistics of a sample, which a weighted distribution function doesn't have, so type is ignored (with a warning if it isn't 1).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'BMisc_dist'
quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), names = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

a distribution function from make_dist.

probs

numeric vector of probabilities in \([0, 1]\).

names

logical; if TRUE, name the result by probs, as quantile does.

...

ignored, except type (see Description).

Value

numeric vector of quantiles.

Examples

F <- weighted_ecdf(c(0, 1), weights = c(0.4, 0.6))
quantile(F, 0.5) # 1
#> 50% 
#>   1
